nameOrigin: set of mammals including monkeys, apes, etc

pokedexEntries.rb: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it is caught.

pokedexEntries.ye: It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.

pokedexEntries.go: If approached while asleep, it may awaken and angrily give chase in a groggy state of semi-sleep.

pokedexEntries.si: It becomes wildly furious if it even senses someone looking at it. It chases anyone that meets its glare.

pokedexEntries.cr: It will beat up anyone who makes it mad, even if it has to chase them until the end of the world.

pokedexEntries.rs: When PRIMEAPE becomes furious, its blood circulation is boosted. In turn, its muscles are made even stronger. However, it also becomes much less intelligent at the same time.

pokedexEntries.fr: It is always outrageously furious. If it gives chase, it will tenaciously track the target no matter how far.

pokedexEntries.lg: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it catches up.

pokedexEntries.em: When it becomes furious, its blood circulation becomes more robust, and its muscles are made stronger. But it also becomes much less intelligent.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.

pokedexEntries.hg: If approached while asleep, it may awaken and angrily give chase in a groggy state of semi-sleep.

pokedexEntries.ss: It becomes wildly furious if it even senses someone looking at it. It chases anyone that meets its glare.

pokedexEntries.bw: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.

pokedexEntries.x: It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.

pokedexEntries.y: It is always outrageously furious. If it gives chase, it will tenaciously track the target no matter how far.

pokedexEntries.oras: When Primeape becomes furious, its blood circulation is boosted. In turn, its muscles are made even stronger. However, it also becomes much less intelligent at the same time.

pokedexEntries.su: It has been known to become so angry that it dies as a result. Its face looks peaceful in death, however.

pokedexEntries.mo: Some researchers theorize that Primeape remains angry even when inside a Poké Ball.

pokedexEntries.us: It will never forgive opponents who have angered it. Even after it has beaten them down until they can’t move, it never ever forgives.

pokedexEntries.um: The blood vessels in its brain are sturdier than those of other Pokémon, so it can stay healthy despite its constant raging.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: It becomes angry if it sees an opponent’s eyes and gets angrier if the opponent runs. Even after it beats the opponent, it is still angry.

pokedexEntries.sc: It becomes wildly furious if it even senses someone looking at it. It chases anyone that meets its glare.

pokedexEntries.vi: Some researchers theorize that Primeape remains angry even when inside a Poké Ball.

pokedexEntries.za: If approached while asleep, it may rouse just enough to fly into a groggy rage and give chase without even knowing what it's doing.
